login.heroTitle: Your association, all in one place.
login.heroCopy: Find your personal information, contributions, and role-specific services in one clear and secure space.
login.badge4: Ready for a realistic association demo
login.highlight1Text: Check your details and contributions in seconds.
login.highlight2Title: The right space for every role
login.highlight2Text: Office members see the tools they need for their responsibilities.
login.highlight3Text: Access is controlled for every member and every organization.
login.signInSubtitle: Use the sign-in details provided by your association.
login.mfaHint: You can enable multi-factor authentication later from Account Security.
login.mfaSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.chooseOrganizationSubtitle: You have access to multiple organizations. Select one to continue.
login.signOutTryAnother: Sign out and try another account
login.errorIdentifierRequired: Enter your email, phone number, or login identifier
login.errorNoMembership: No active organization membership was found for this account.
login.errorExpiredMfa: The MFA session expired. Please sign in again.
initialPassword.title: Choose your personal password
initialPassword.lead: Your association gave you a temporary password.
initialPassword.notice: To protect your account, choose a new password now. No email or SMS is required.
initialPassword.errorLength: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
initialPassword.errorMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.forgotPassword.title: Reset password
auth.forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link. If you're already signed in, you can also trigger this from Account Security.
auth.forgotPassword.emailSentMessage: If an account with that email exists, we've sent a reset link.
auth.resetPassword.title: Set new password
auth.resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password for your account. After sign-in, review Account Security to enable MFA.
auth.resetPassword.missingToken: Missing reset token. Use the link from your email.
auth.resetPassword.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
auth.resetPassword.successMessage: You can now sign in with your new password and continue hardening the account from Account Security.
auth.acceptInvite.title: Accept invitation
auth.acceptInvite.subtitle: You've been invited to join an organization. Set up your account to get started.
auth.acceptInvite.missingToken: Missing invitation token. Use the link from your invitation email.
auth.acceptInvite.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
auth.acceptInvite.welcomeMessage: Your account has been set up and you're now signed in. The next recommended step is to review your account security.
auth.acceptInvite.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
auth.mfa.subtitle: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
auth.mfa.scanInstructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy).
auth.mfa.cantScan: Can't scan? Manually enter the key:
auth.mfa.enabledMessage: You'll be prompted for a code each time you sign in.
